evidence.detail: h1 renders {{page_title}} as plain text — no anchor tag, no href
page_title() returns 'Matchups Calculator' with no link URL provided to template
No link back to /matchups/ anywhere in the template — once a search is active, there is no 'reset' navigation anchor

triage.fix_sketch:
In decksite/templates/matchups.mustache, add a reset link (e.g. `

← All Matchups

`) at the top of the template, or expose `matchups_url = url_for('metagame.matchups')` in decksite/views/matchups.py and render it in the template as a breadcrumb link near the Query section heading.
triage.notes: Purely additive UI change — add a link element; no logic changes needed. The exact placement (banner, top of page, above Query section) is a minor product judgment call but either approach is low-risk.
